articles.title: RBI Issues Guidelines on Climate-Related Financial Risk Management
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has introduced a standardized framework for Regulated Entities to address climate-induced financial vulnerabilities.
prelims: Applies to all Scheduled Commercial Banks, Tier 4 Urban Co-operative Banks, and All-India Financial Institutions.
Mandates governance structures aligned with Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) recommendations.
Requires periodic climate scenario analysis and stress testing of asset portfolios.
articles.mains: Use to substantiate answers on financial stability, sustainable finance, and India's Panchamrit climate commitments.

articles.title: SCO RATS Council Meeting Strengthens Regional Counter-Terror Framework
articles.summary: Member countries of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation reaffirmed commitments to combat joint security threats and cyber-terrorism.
prelims: Regional Anti-Terrorist Structure (RATS) is a permanent organ of the SCO headquartered in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
Focuses on information sharing, joint exercises, and combating the 'three evils': terrorism, separatism, and extremism.
India became a full member of the SCO during the Astana Summit in 2017.
articles.mains: Use as an example of multi-alignment strategy and regional security architecture in Eurasia.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: 'Matsya 6000' Prepares for Final Deep-Sea Trials
articles.summary: Ministry of Earth Sciences reports significant milestones in the indigenous human submersible program aimed at blue economy exploration.
prelims: Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES); National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) is the key executing agency.
Designed to carry 3 humans to a depth of 6,000 meters for polymetallic nodule exploration.
India holds exclusive rights for polymetallic nodule exploration in the Central Indian Ocean Basin assigned by the International Seabed Authority (ISA).
articles.mains: Use to highlight scientific self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat), energy security, and Sustainable Development Goal 14 (Life Below Water).

articles.title: ECI Proposes Harmonization of Common Electoral Rolls Across States
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India advocated for a unified voter database to streamline local body and parliamentary elections.
prelims: Article 324 mandates the Election Commission of India to conduct elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President/Vice-President.
Article 243K and 243ZA vest the power of preparing electoral rolls for local bodies in State Election Commissions (SECs).
Adoption of a common roll requires amendments to state electoral laws or voluntary adoption by state governments.
articles.mains: Use in questions regarding electoral reforms, administrative efficiency, and cooperative federalism.

articles.title: Bhu-Aadhaar (ULPIN) Integration Achieves High Rural Coverage
articles.summary: The Unique Land Parcel Identification Number system enhances land titling accuracy and reduces rural property disputes across states.
prelims: ULPIN is a 14-digit alphanumeric identification number assigned to every surveyed parcel of land.
Part of the Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP) under the Ministry of Rural Development.
Utilizes longitude and latitude coordinates based on geo-referenced cadastral maps.
articles.mains: Use as an illustration of digital spatial governance, reduction of land litigation, and empowerment of agricultural credit access.
